ai_summary: Here is the executive summary:  360 ONE WAM LIMITED has announced a significant leadership restructure, appointing Aashish Agarwal, a veteran investment banker from Jefferies, as the new Chief Executive Officer effective February 15, 2027. Current Managing Director & CEO, Karan Bhagat, will transition to Vice Chairman and Managing Director, focusing on group strategy, capital allocation, and key client relationships. This strategic realignment aims to strengthen the group's leadership, drive growth across its wealth, asset, and capital markets verticals, and position the firm for large-scale expansion in India's growing economy, with no apparent red flags.
